blocks.html: Объект перемещается по параболической баллистической траектории к конечной точке приземления Target Location (X, Y, Z), достигая в апогее максимальной высоты Height

blocks.code:
import pse

pse.initialize()

plate = pse.FaithPlate()
plate.create(location=(0, 0, -100))

plate.release_on_land = True
plate.global_coords = False

plate.color_on = (0, 255, 0)
plate.color_off = (255, 0, 0)

# Включить панель
plate.state = 1

blocks.html:
• RuntimeError - игра не запущена или вернула код ошибки
  • ValueError - невалидный state или компоненты цвета вне 0..255
Element Description: A vanilla faith plate like in Portal 2
Important: Everything common is inherited from Element. Only unique properties are described here. See Elements > Element

head: Property
Type
Access
Description
rows: Release the object from hands if it falls on the faith plate
Use global coordinates for the Target Location
Faith plate highlight color in the activated state. RGB, 0..255
Faith plate highlight color in the deactivated state. RGB, 0..255

blocks.html: The object moves along a parabolic ballistic trajectory to the landing point Target Location (X, Y, Z), reaching maximum height at the apex at the height Height

blocks.code:
import pse

pse.initialize()

plate = pse.FaithPlate()
plate.create(location=(0, 0, -100))

plate.release_on_land = True
plate.global_coords = False

plate.color_on = (0, 255, 0)
plate.color_off = (255, 0, 0)

# Enable the plate
plate.state = 1

blocks.html:
• RuntimeError - game not running or returned an error code
  • ValueError - invalid state or color components outside 0..255
